title: Beijing's No-Fly Zone, Qatar Airways' Worst Crisis Ever, and UK Air Traffic Control Melts Down Again
summary: A suicidal pilot crashes into one of Beijing's tallest towers, and China responds with a no-fly zone almost the size of Italy. Plus, Qatar Airways says the Iran war hit harder than COVID, UK air traffic control breaks for the second time in two weeks, and Delta has a rough weekend in the air and on the route map.
